label: Physical Works
description:
A collection of wearable artefacts and functional morphologies investigating how physical identity is altered and perceived from external points of view.

Using mutation as a shared visual logic, these works treat the body as an interface between internal experience and external interpretation. Each object reshapes the silhouette, introducing anatomical extensions that alter how the body is read.

Developed through an exchange between digital modelling and material experimentation, the artefacts are realised through 3D printing, casting, and hybrid fabrication.

This translation from image to matter turns speculative anatomies into tangible, wearable structures that negotiate materiality and perception.
